unique_feature_groups.recommendation: First integration candidate: port bounded storage and review additive schema; test stalled child/uncertain ACK/backpressure/restart with current net ledger and observation archive. Do not claim storage failure leaves software-only protection operational.

unique_feature_groups.difference: Single service retains broker credentials and checks durable owner epoch immediately before broker mutation; persistent request ids prevent blind retry; Alpaca/futures share authority mutex.
unique_feature_groups.recommendation: Preserve as separate integration component until startup, streaming transport, store and reconciliation paths are tested together. Do not overwrite 30.12 server/installer. The branch disables streaming and changes credential topology.

unique_feature_groups.recommendation: The pure risk calculator can be adapted after configuration/risk comparison; keep current account limits and default fixed capital. Do not activate capital expansion or treat policy shocks as calibrated VaR.
